name: Adside — Meta Ads, Google Ads & LinkedIn Ads reporting for agencies
description:
Adside is the ad management platform for agencies. Connect it to Claude to read your clients' paid media data — Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads — plus each client's brand kit, tracked competitors and your agency's saved knowledge, all from a chat.

What you can ask Claude once connected:
• Ad performance and campaign reporting: spend, impressions, clicks, CPC, CPM, CTR, conversions and cost per result across Meta, Google and LinkedIn for any date range, with period-over-period comparison and top campaigns.
• Brand kit: a client's identity, visual assets, positioning, tone of voice and products — so Claude writes ad copy, headlines and briefs on-brand.
• Competitor intelligence: which competitor companies you track for a client and the notes saved on their ads and strategy (Meta Ad Library research, messaging, creative angles).
• Agency knowledge (Brain): browse and read client-specific and agency-level pages — strategy, playbooks, learnings — so answers are grounded in what your team already knows.

Example prompts:
• "How did Acme's Meta and Google spend and CPA trend over the last 30 days vs. the previous period?"
• "Summarize Acme's brand positioning and tone of voice, then draft five LinkedIn ad headlines."
• "Which competitors do we track for Acme, and what do our notes say about their Meta ads?"
• "Build a weekly client report for Acme's paid social and paid search."

Built for agencies: every connection is scoped to one client, so an account manager can only read the client they authorized. Multi-client agencies connect once per client.

All tools are read-only — Adside never edits campaigns, budgets or ad accounts through this connector. Sign in with your Adside account (OAuth) — no API keys. Requires an Adside account with at least one client; ad performance requires a connected Meta, Google or LinkedIn ad account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adside — Meta Ads, Google Ads & LinkedIn Ads reporting for agencies to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adside — Meta Ads, Google Ads & LinkedIn Ads reporting for agencies to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.adside.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adside — Meta Ads, Google Ads & LinkedIn Ads reporting for agencies MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adside — Meta Ads, Google Ads & LinkedIn Ads reporting for agencies provides these MCP tools: get_ad_performance, get_workspace_brand_details, list_brain_directory, list_competitors, list_workspaces, read_brain_page, and whoami.
